description: Ex-RAF XF463, TOC 13 May 1958 (Bharat Rakshak); flew with 20 Sqn into the early 1990s and appears in the IAF film Salt of the Earth. Presented by ACM S K Mehra (alumnus) and installed April 1991 opposite the school building (WBI). Inside school grounds: permission needed. Coordinates: OSM fix on the school.
